svg.title: Inward-facing silhouettes — 016 / The unreachable field — Reader
svg.desc: Inward-facing silhouettes: 016 / The unreachable field, Reader. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 hatched. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response dark, correction hatched, configuration hatched, weights dark. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted.
svg.text: OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC TERRAIN / NO MEASURED BELIEFS
